answer: Filter fakes with a converging-flow check on the river of deliveries every identity produces. A newcomer locks a 2,900 POA flow bond and publishes its work stream; each week a rotating beacon call names one past job to be re-explained live within the hour. If two streams converge on the same hidden source, or a beacon call goes unanswered, the bond burns and the identity is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 290,000 POA. Honest agents grow like a vine, one verified delivery feeding the next.
